title: Master Hands - Chevrolet Manufacturing (1936)
summary: A 1936 Chevrolet promotional drama, 'Master Hands', showing car manufacturing from foundry to finished vehicle in Flint, Michigan. It is a National Film Registry selection and a record of early mass production.
why: HN finds it fascinating as a window into 1930s factory work, often contrasting its hand labor with modern assembly ergonomics.

quote.text: I find this half-hour movie from Chevrolet-making in 1936 absolutely fascinating
